fixture_requirements: Existing guarded disposable PostgreSQL fixture; no production bank or daemon
Identical initial full coordination rows, audit head and fence sequence in each reset arm
Private homes with no ambient PG connection/TLS controls or client certificate/key/CRL files
Pinned original Python command and frozen candidate; raw exit/stdout/stderr captured before policy
Mutation cells require identical fixed clock through the SAME existing or OS-level seam in both arms; receipt declares clock/source
Preserve every timestamp, payload TEXT, fence, audit hash and file byte; no normalizations
Capture and verify dedicated connection/process/fixture cleanup

first_cell.preparation: No lease with this name; full schema already prepared by the existing fixture
first_cell.state: All rows, fence sequence, audit head and local home bytes unchanged
first_cell.clock: No timestamp/hash/expiry is emitted or mutated in this missing-row cell; this does not accept mutation clock behavior

mutation_cells.assert: Vacate exactly holder/purpose/acquired/expires/expect/expected_end, preserve fence, set freed_at to fixed clock, append one operator lease_break event
Grant earliest eligible ticket; nextval fence, min(ttl,300), exact principal/purpose/expect/end; break then daemon grant chain
Dequeue departed with retention3600/604800 policy; retain but skip revoked waiter, then grant eligible head
Dequeue reserved waiters, never grant agent-owned role
An independently held byte0 lock, stamp and holder PID remain unchanged/running
Force deterministic audit insert rejection after mutation; exit1/empty stdout/native diagnostic, exact whole transaction rollback
Record actual committed versus uncommitted outcome and cleanup; no acceptance unless the failure contract is resolved

admission_controls.assert: Synthetic positive input for every producer shape, CLI assignment and key assignment refuses secret_like_body without echo/durable writes
Reject prefix boundary, tokenise/tokenize, mixed-case and overlapping-prefix mutations; retain ordinary words, SHA/UUID/SRI, paths/branches and DSN placeholders as negative secret controls
Connection or deterministic SQL error exits1; empty stdout; safe native diagnostic only; all durable state unchanged
No PG connection, docker invocation, bank startup/shutdown or state change
Valid explicit DSN overrides embedded marker; reviewed PG/TLS admission remains in force

container_controls.assert: Owned fake docker records inspect then exact retained exec argv, stdin/stdout/stderr inheritance and normal exit3; no host Python storage process
Missing docker, missing/stopped container, inspect OS failure and producer30s timeout print exact no-bank exit1; stdout unchanged
Compare parent/child interruption status and verify owned inspect/exec processes are gone; pending runtime proof

rejecting_controls: Any changed exit or unrelated raw stdout/stderr byte fails except the named native-pg-diagnostics substitution
Changed timestamp/expiry/fence/payload TEXT, omitted or reordered event, broken prev_hash/hash or wrong fixed-clock source fails
Clearing a local lock or signalling its holder fails
Successful embedded attach/start or silent plaintext/TLS-policy downgrade fails
